functions.get_item(sku): returns dict {sku:str, name:str, price_cents:int}; raises KeyError if sku unknown
functions.get_customer(customer_id): returns dict {id:str, name:str, discount_pct:float (10 means 10%), region:str}; raises KeyError if unknown
functions.get_tax_pct(region): returns float percent (8.25 means 8.25%); raises KeyError if region unknown
functions.apply_percent_cents(amount_cents, pct): returns int cents = round-half-up(amount_cents * pct / 100); pct is a percent number

value.conventions: all money is integer cents; percentages are plain percent numbers (not fractions); unknown keys raise KeyError; module loads data/ relative to its own file

why: Minimal read-only API so invoice.py never touches data files; integer cents avoid float money errors; one shared rounding helper keeps totals consistent.
